title: Be a licensed auctioneer
what: Carry on business as an auctioneer, or sell by auction, only while holding an auctioneer's licence (or a clerk's licence under a licensed auctioneer).

sources.title: Auctioneers Act 1935 (NT)
sources.quote: a person shall not: (a) carry on business as an auctioneer unless he holds an auctioneer's licence; or (b) sell or offer to sell by auction unless he holds: (i) an auctioneer's licence; or (ii) a clerk's licence
